{"id":1753361571,"question_id":42,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1756548839,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1753361571/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Trapping Rain Water","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int trap(vector<int>& heights) {\n        int left = 0;\n        int right = heights.size()-1;\n\n        int left_max_ht = 0;\n        int right_max_ht = 0;\n\n        int water_trapped = 0;\n\n        while(left <= right)\n        {\n            if(heights[left] > heights[right])\n            {\n                left_max_ht = max(left_max_ht , heights[left]);\n                left++;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                water_trapped += (right_max_ht - heights[right]);\n                right_max_ht = max(right_max_ht , heights[right]);\n                right--;\n            }\n        }\n    return water_trapped;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"trapping-rain-water","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":726}
